# Sampling a noisy signal

The cell below runs against a warm Python kernel. Change the **number of cycles**
and only this cell re-runs — the figure it produced updates in place, with the
page never moving.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

cycles = 3                     # ← edit me
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 600)
y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * cycles * x)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.2))
ax.plot(x, y, color="#4c6ef5", lw=2.2)
ax.fill_between(x, y, alpha=0.12, color="#4c6ef5")
ax.set_title(f"sin(2π · {cycles}t)", fontsize=13)
ax.set_xlabel("t")
ax.set_ylim(-1.3, 1.3)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

Because the kernel is warm, the re-run is instant: no interpreter start-up, no
re-importing numpy, no full-page reload. Just the one cell and everything
downstream of it.
